hook: AI rewrote a model's weights by hand

beats.say: A free vision model already knew Galápagos animals inside its image features. A simple readout told mockingbirds from other birds 98 percent of the time.
But asked directly, the model called almost every iguana native, scoring a coin-flip 50 percent.

With gradient training switched off, Claude and GPT models took turns reading weights and writing in computed changes. The method was first built on 1,611 camera-trap photos. Every change was a number a frontier model calculated and wrote in.
